subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: What public Talk idle-timeout contract should OpenClaw support for deactivating inactive Talk sessions after Voice Wake starts them?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public lifecycle/config behavior across Talk surfaces, so automation should not choose the permanent scope, default, disabled behavior, units, bounds, or reset semantics alone.

options.title: Add canonical Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add an additive Talk config field with explicit units, bounds, disabled behavior, reset events, docs, protocol, and macOS runtime support.

options.title: Scope only to Voice Wake sessions
options.body: Track activation source and auto-deactivate only Talk sessions started by Voice Wake, leaving manually started Talk unchanged.

options.title: Defer to broader voice lifecycle design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers design a broader Talk and Voice Wake lifecycle policy across native and realtime surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add canonical Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add an additive Talk config field with explicit units, bounds, disabled behavior, reset events, docs, protocol, and macOS runtime support.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the public Talk config/protocol contract, and steipete has recent history on the Talk config loaders and defaults this would extend.
